title: Tripe Stew with Mediterranean Twist
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tripe, inspired by the Mediterranean diet. This recipe is perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Tripe
ingredients.notes: Cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the tripe and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the canned tomatoes, chicken broth, red wine (if using), Mediterranean oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until the tripe is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley (optional).
